headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for the Tesla Wall Connector (Gen 3) local API.
footerDisplay: To use the **Apple Home Energy view** option you need Homebridge 2.3.0 or later with **Matter enabled** on this plugin's child bridge (Bridge Settings → enable Matter), then pair the Matter bridge in the Home app. If Matter isn't available the option is skipped safely and the plugin keeps working over HomeKit/Eve.

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: Local IP address of the Wall Connector.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll /api/1/vitals, in milliseconds.

matter.title: Show in the Apple Home Energy view (via Matter)
matter.description: Also publish the charger over Matter as an outlet with live electrical measurements, so it shows watts on its tile and feeds your home energy total. Requires Homebridge 2.3.0+ with Matter enabled on this plugin's child bridge.
